protocol.primary_whisper: original AB_readings only, all variants retained; no selection by Reazon agreement

protocol.reazon_body_output: at least one nonpadding estimated token point in half-open core, no boundary tolerance or invented ends
protocol.recognition_accuracy: UNKNOWN without Japanese audio truth, even when output lies in core
protocol.pair_comparison: NFKC and whitespace/punctuation removal only; equal full-clip hypothesis / contains primary / different surface text. Count separately whether Reazon has core token points. Not proof of complete same-core sentence match. Kana/kanji differences are not semantic conflicts.
protocol.ja_duplicate: aligned temporal overlap separately from elsewhere literal substring, neither proves same-utterance duplication or novelty
protocol.short_fragment: no full-sentence recovery credit; exact Japanese unknown
